structure Offering (B : Directed G I Z K P) {F : ℕ → ℕ → Postage} (A : Scouts (F:=F)) (f r : Return.Wages) : Prop where
  holds N m p : m<N → ∀ l u : ℝ,l ≤ u → let s := Icc l u
    ∀ Q : In B.a m p, Curve (B.a.budget (m+1)) Q s → (∀ x∈s,Lives B.bake N (m+1) p (Q x) ∧ (Q x).beta ∈ band B.a (m+1)) →
      ∃ X v, ∃ (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (T : Wood B m p) (d : Bookings B m p f) (χ : Push.SectorMeasure.Chi), (∀ x∈s,atlas B N T d χ r (Q x) X (v x) (τ x)) ∧
      (∀ x∈s, Local X (B.a.budget m) (v x) (forecastE B.a m) (forecastK B.a m A (Q x).beta)) ∧ Compared X (B.a.budget m) v s

proof_context.conclusion: For every input curve on `Icc l u` there are one listing `X`, sources `v x`, scalars `tau x` with `atlas`, `Local` budgets `forecastE`/`forecastK` at each x, and `Compared X v s`.

lemma glazing : Use.Offering A.B S p (radiusW Y):= by

  obtain ⟨Z⟩:= Roof.arches h.conducts l hL H (θ:=s) (y:=a) (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr hab)
  have hc :=hm' _ _ (step_paid A.B.a m)
  let W:= Classical.choice (Rain.learns (R:=R) (A:=A) l h.conducts.income.grow.1 h.conducts.full) -- order
  obtain ⟨d,hD,hE⟩:= (Rain.topped h l Z H hL hh hc ht W isCompact_Icc).exists
  let M:= Classical.choice (Tree.select (A.B.a.clock.op m p).ratio (A.B.a.clock.op m p).patch.odd_side); let t:=Opera.forum (m:=m) (n:=p) A.B R
  exact ⟨opening Z, paint Z hL W d, stanzaFee Z d M,M,t,Chi.canonical,(fun i hi=> sprint h l Z H hL hh hc W d i hi M t (hE i hi)), (fun i hi=>varnish h l Z H hL hh hc W d i hi (hE i hi) (hD i hi)), Rain.blinking h l Z H hL hh hc W d hE hD⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `glazing` proves `Offering` by building the listing, sources and scalar `stanzaFee` from the localized families and packaging `sprint`, `varnish` and `blinking`.
